DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC).

The clinical findings of an erythematous, crusted plaque with irregular borders on sun-exposed or chronic trauma sites (penis, finger), combined with biopsy results showing nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures, are diagnostic for SCC.
